name: University of Malta
summary: Malta's university with fourteen faculties on four campuses, taught in English; it treats the IB Diploma as a local qualification.

ib.text: IB Diploma with 28+ points and 3+ in a language, a science and a humanistic subject, plus Maths, English and Maltese at SEC level (comparable IB subjects may count). Some courses add subjects.

notes: HL subjects normally meet a MATSEC Advanced Level requirement and SL an Intermediate one; 7, 6, 5, 4 IB points equal grades A, B, C, D, and ab initio subjects never count.

For October 2027 entry, a non-Maltese applicant with under four years of secondary schooling in Malta may offer another language at SEC level 3 or grade 5 in place of Maltese, unless a course names Maltese.
The IB counts as a local qualification: the application fee is €35 (€75 late), course pages show "No fees apply" for EU/EEA students, and Medicine and capped courses take no late applications.
